title: Theo and the Oath
premise: Ada Okonkwo has spent her life guarding the Hollow Gate, the one seam between the mundane valley and the realm of magic, which cannot cross the boundary. When a quiet archivist named Theo arrives for a first date and is named in a century-old prophecy as the Oathbearer, he is dragged through the gate into a world on the brink of war: the usurper Veyra has shattered the old covenant that bound the realms in balance, and her armies march on the free cities. Theo's forgotten past—he is the reincarnated first Oathbearer whose betrayal broke the covenant—surfaces piece by piece as Ada guides him through hostile lands to reforge the oath at the Wellspring of Names. In the climax, Theo must choose between reclaiming his old identity's power or surrendering it entirely; by giving up his memories of both lives, he seals the new covenant, while Ada inherits the gatekeeper's burden with a choice she never expected: the gate now opens from her side alone.
about_author: Felix Thackeray is a former cartographer who spent a decade mapping river deltas before turning to fiction, a career that left him obsessed with borders and the people who live along them. He writes fantasy about obligations, oaths, and the small stubborn acts that hold worlds together.

chapters.title: The Keeper's Ordinary Evening
chapters.summary: Ada prepares for her first date in years, leaving her grandmother's gatekeeping duties briefly unattended in the valley where magic cannot follow. POV: Ada. Emotional beat: longing for a life beyond duty, undercut by guilt.

chapters.title: A Name in Old Ink
chapters.summary: Theo, an archivist, arrives for the date; browsing Ada's family shelf, he finds a prophecy book naming 'the Oathbearer' with his own face sketched a century ago. POV: Theo. Emotional beat: uncanny dread disguised as curiosity.

chapters.title: What the Gate Remembers
chapters.summary: The Hollow Gate stirs without being opened and pulls Theo through; Ada follows, breaking her own law. They land in a border village where magic runs wild. POV: alternating. Emotional beat: disorientation and shared responsibility.

chapters.title: The Usurper's Shadow
chapters.summary: Refugees describe Veyra's conquest of the northern holds and her shattering of the covenant; a dying soldier recognizes Theo and calls him 'the Betrayer.' POV: Ada. Emotional beat: fear hardening into resolve.

chapters.title: Road of Small Mercies
chapters.summary: The pair joins a refugee caravan led by the smuggler Brannoc; Theo experiences his first flash of past-life memory during an ambush. POV: Theo. Emotional beat: terror of becoming someone he doesn't know.

chapters.title: The Free City of Sablehold
chapters.summary: They reach Sablehold, where the Council of Nine refuses to believe the covenant is broken until Ada displays her keeper's sigil. POV: Ada. Emotional beat: frustration with politics while armies gather.

chapters.title: Veyra's Offer
chapters.summary: An envoy offers Theo amnesty if he surrenders his claim as Oathbearer; a memory reveals he once made a similar bargain—and doomed the realms. POV: Theo. Emotional beat: temptation and self-loathing.

chapters.title: The Cartographer's Daughter
chapters.summary: Ada learns her grandmother hid generations of gatekeepers' failures; her lineage exists to watch for Theo's return. POV: Ada. Emotional beat: grief and fury at a life built on someone else's prophecy.

chapters.title: Ash Over the Riverlands
chapters.summary: Veyra burns the river towns; the caravan shelters survivors, and Theo saves a child using instinctive magic he shouldn't have. POV: Theo. Emotional beat: awe curdling into fear of his own power.

chapters.title: The Council Fractures
chapters.summary: Sablehold's Council splits between fighting, fleeing, and appeasing Veyra; Brannoc proposes the desperate road to the Wellspring of Names. POV: Ada. Emotional beat: disillusionment, then commitment.

chapters.title: Through the Weeping Pass
chapters.summary: The company crosses a mountain pass haunted by echoes of broken oaths; each traveler hears their worst promise repeated back. POV: alternating. Emotional beat: intimacy forged through exposed shame.

chapters.title: The First Oathbearer's Tomb
chapters.summary: In a frozen shrine, they find the original Oathbearer's grave—Theo's own name carved on it, dated a hundred years before his birth. POV: Theo. Emotional beat: vertigo of identity collapse.

chapters.title: Midpoint: The Wellspring of Names
chapters.summary: They reach the Wellspring, but reforging the covenant requires the true name of the Betrayer—which Theo cannot remember because he gave it away. POV: Ada. Emotional beat: hope dashed at the threshold.

chapters.title: Veyra's Version
chapters.summary: Captured by Veyra's forces, Theo hears her side: she was the covenant's sacrificed ward, and the old oath fed realms on people like her. POV: Theo. Emotional beat: moral ground shifting beneath him.

chapters.title: Escape and Cost
chapters.summary: Brannoc dies covering their escape; Ada pulls Theo out through a collapsing waystation, and they finally speak honestly of love and doom. POV: Ada. Emotional beat: love declared under sentence of death.

chapters.title: The Valley That Forgot
chapters.summary: Ada returns home seeking her grandmother's hidden records and finds the valley's memory of her already fading—the price of her crossing. POV: Ada. Emotional beat: homesickness for a place erasing her.

chapters.title: The Betrayer's Confession
chapters.summary: A residual echo in the tomb's ring shows Theo his past self's full betrayal: he traded the covenant's name to save one person, dooming millions. POV: Theo. Emotional beat: acceptance of guilt without excuse.

chapters.title: Armies at the Gates
chapters.summary: Veyra besieges Sablehold; the free cities send desperate envoys begging the Oathbearer to act now, any way he can. POV: alternating. Emotional beat: crushing weight of being everyone's answer.

chapters.title: The Counter-Offer
chapters.summary: Theo confronts Veyra and proposes a new covenant written with her, not against her; she refuses, but her hesitation cracks her army's certainty. POV: Theo. Emotional beat: courage as persuasion, not force.

chapters.title: Climax: The Reforging
chapters.summary: At the reopened Hollow Gate, Theo speaks his true name into the Wellspring and surrenders all his memories—both lives—to bind the new covenant as Veyra's assault breaks against it. POV: alternating. Emotional beat: sacrifice as the only honest payment.

chapters.title: A Stranger at the Door
chapters.summary: Theo wakes in the valley with no past; Ada, now sole keeper of a gate that opens only from her side, chooses to introduce herself again. POV: Ada. Emotional beat: bittersweet tenderness, beginning over.

chapters.title: The Book Rewritten
chapters.summary: The prophecy book's final page now bears fresh ink: not a fate, but a blank line awaiting whoever keeps the gate next. POV: Ada. Emotional beat: quiet hope—identity as something written, not owed.
